name: Greatwood Vale
summary: The Grimtotem have seized Greatwood Vale in the eastern foothills of the Stonetalon Mountains. The perilous Webwinder Path leads into the forested valley, which the tribe now uses to launch bloody assaults on nearby settlements.

sections.title: A Contested Valley
sections.body: Greatwood Vale has become a violent frontier off the Webwinder Path. Grundig Darkcloud leads the Grimtotem who have moved into the vale in force. They block safe passage and terrorize the surrounding foothills.

sections.title: The Scourge of Camp Aparaje
sections.body: From Greatwood Vale, Grimtotem raiders swept into nearby Camp Aparaje and slaughtered nearly every tauren there. Makaba Flathoof escaped the attack. Now he directs vengeful Horde warriors into the heart of the vale to kill the renegade Grimtotem and end Grundig Darkcloud's rule.

faq.q: Who controls Greatwood Vale right now?
faq.answer: Grundig Darkcloud leads the Grimtotem tribe occupying Greatwood Vale. Their warbands and spellcasters menace anyone traveling through the woods.
Grimtotem raiders attacked Camp Aparaje from Greatwood Vale and massacred most of its peaceful tauren residents. Makaba Flathoof survived and seeks vengeance against the raiders and their leader.

faq.q: Why is the Horde fighting the Grimtotem here?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem have not formally joined the Horde, despite Magatha's presence in Thunder Bluff. Grundig Darkcloud's followers attacked fellow tauren at Camp Aparaje, so survivors called on Horde warriors for aid.

angles.text: For loyal children of Thunder Bluff, cleansing Greatwood Vale is a sorrowful, personal duty after the Grimtotem slaughtered fellow tauren at Camp Aparaje.
Securing Greatwood Vale helps protect Malaka'jin, the fragile southern outpost, from sudden flank attacks by rogue Grimtotem.
